title: The Moiré Rosette & Halftone Screen Interference

generatedProceduralAssets.description: High-resolution Swiss modernist graphic design blueprint illustrating the 30° CMYK halftone angle matrix (Black 45°, Cyan 15°, Magenta 75°, Yellow 0°), optical beat frequency moiré wavelength curves, 10x prepress loupe inspection of closed rosettes vs acute moiré clashes, and Karl Gerstner programmed kinetic typography.

midjourneyPrompts.title: Plate 1 (The Prepress Loupe Rosette Inspection)
